sights.address: Orlando–Kissimmee line, S Orange Blossom Trail, FL
sights.w: Founded 1949 by Owen Godwin, Orlando's oldest theme park — 'Alligator Capital of the World' with 2,000+ gators and crocs, a breeding marsh, a zip line and the 1961 Gatorland Express railroad.
sights.k: gator alligator wildlife zoo family historic

sights.w: Retro amusement-and-shopping strip on US-192 with free Friday- and Saturday-night classic car shows.
